title: New Line and Edit Line keep their other fields, order and buttons
custom_preconds:
Setup (manual QA tester and Claude session)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as an Admin (all permissions) at {Location-A} (for example Staging Heavy Duty - 9919) on the What/Why QA build.
  • Customer {Customer-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154710 Fleet) has a contact person and an asset, {Asset-A} (for example ZZAUTOTEST-WW-C154710 Truck).
  • Work order {Work-order-1} (for example S2-15440) is open for {Customer-A} and {Asset-A} at {Location-A}, not invoiced.
  • Canned line {Canned-line-A} (for example "Replace - Brake pot") is set up at {Location-A}.
custom_steps:
1. Open {Work-order-1} and go to its Lines tab.
  2. Click New Line.
  3. Read every field and button in the window, from top to bottom.
  4. Pick {Canned-line-A} in the Title field.
  5. Click Save & Close.
  6. Read the new line's title and description on the Lines tab.
  7. Click the new line's title to open Edit Line.
  8. Read every field and button in the window, from top to bottom.
  9. Close the window without saving.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 3: the window holds, in this order, the AI SHOPCOACH LINE BUILDER link, Title, Description, Technicians (Add Technician), Labor Rate, Estimated Time and Tech Time, then the buttons Save & Add Part, Save & Add Line and Save & Close. Only the first two field names are new; nothing is added, removed or moved.
  • Step 5: the line saves and the window closes.
  • Step 6: the new line shows {Canned-line-A}'s title and description, exactly as the canned line holds them.
  • Step 8: Edit Line holds, in this order, Title, Description, Status, Technicians, Labor Rate, Estimated Time, Tech Time, the SHOPCOACH LABOR GUIDE link, Delete and Save & Close, with Title and Description showing the saved values.

Source — where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-11257; story SV-10130 (Story 1, The Work Order Line Dialog); PRD "What Are You Doing / Why Are You Doing It (What/Why)", Confluence 845348896, version of 13 Oct 2026, S1-R7, read 13 Oct 2026; design canvas board 1.1 (New Line - before), 1.2 (New Line - after), 1.4 (Edit Line - before) and 1.5 (Edit Line - after), 13 Oct copy; tech plan "Title and Description - Technical Implementation Plan" (dated 2026-09-23, shared by the QA lead 13 Oct 2026), FR-005; Source-verified 13 October 2026; not yet build-verified (a What/Why QA build exists; verification by the build verification session).

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S1-R7: “Nothing else about the dialog changes: same fields in the same order, same validation, same values saved.”
  • Tech plan FR-005: “Nothing else in the dialog changes — fields, order, validation, saved values; no existing line data altered (S1-R7, S1-N1).”
